caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden secretary desk with a rich reddish-brown color. The furniture piece has two main sections: an upper cabinet and a lower desk with drawers. The upper section features two large arched doors with intricate molding, topped by a broken pediment with a central ornamental shell and two carved statuettes, one at each end of the pediment. The doors are fitted with brass handles at the center. Below the cabinet, there is a slanted writing surface that likely opens to reveal storage space inside. The lower section consists of a central compartment with a door, flanked by three drawers on each side, each drawer having two ornate brass handles. The desk stands on four cabriole legs with decorative carved feet, and additional brass handles are present on the sides of the lower section. The drawing is done on a beige background, and details such as wood grain, shadows, and highlights are rendered with care to indicate texture and depth.
title: Cabinet-top Desk
